meta.name: benchmark-logging
meta.description: Define benchmark runs and log outcomes with consistent metrics, acceptance criteria, and reproducible artifact references.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定义基准测试并记录可复现的结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要标准化性能测试并记录可复现的指标
copy.tagline_en: Define benchmark runs and log reproducible outcomes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to standardize performance tests and log reproducible metrics

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你定义和记录基准测试运行，包括一致的指标、验收标准和可复现的工件引用。
howto.when: 当你提到“运行基准测试”、“比较基线与 sciClaw”、“记录基准结果”或“添加验收标准”时触发。

say.text: 运行基准测试，比较基线流程和 sciClaw 流程。
say.note: Claude 会开始定义并执行基准测试记录。

say.text: 记录本次基准测试的结果，包括指标和验收决策。
say.note: Claude 会记录指标值、工件路径和通过/失败判断。

say.text: 添加验收标准：任务成功率 ≥ 95%。
say.note: Claude 会将此标准纳入基准记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you define and log benchmark runs with consistent metrics, acceptance criteria, and reproducible artifact references.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "run benchmark", "compare baseline vs sciclaw", "log benchmark outcomes", or "add acceptance criteria".

say_en.text: Run a benchmark comparing baseline and sciClaw workflows.
say_en.note: Claude will start defining and logging the benchmark run.

say_en.text: Log the outcomes of this benchmark run, including metrics and acceptance decision.
say_en.note: Claude will record metric values, artifact paths, and pass/fail decision.

say_en.text: Add acceptance criteria: task success rate >= 95%.
say_en.note: Claude will include this criterion in the benchmark record.
